properties.titulo_evento: Just one in three Americans back Iran war, most unsure of Trump’s goals, poll finds
properties.descricao: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 69% of Americans think President Donald Trump has not “clearly explained the goals of U.S. military involvement in Iran.”

properties.titulo_evento: Iran war depleted US Patriot missile stockpiles, creating readiness challenges, experts say
properties.descricao: The U.S. has depleted roughly two-thirds of its pre-war Patriot missile interceptor inventory during the conflict with Iran, new analysis says.

properties.titulo_evento: Iran to get Chinese shoulder-launched missile systems in weeks, sources say
properties.descricao: Iran is expected to receive within weeks a first shipment out of up to 400 Chinese-made shoulder-fired air defense missile launchers.

properties.titulo_evento: Ukraine’s F-16s are being worn out from intercepting Russian drones
properties.descricao: Ukrainian F-16s have destroyed more than 2,500 one-way attack drones, but repeated interceptions are wearing out the country's small fleet.

properties.titulo_evento: The Atlantic Brief: The Strait of Hormuz and the Future of Free Navigation

properties.titulo_evento: Venezuela gov’t and opposition to hold talks aimed at path to elections
properties.descricao: Talks to be led by former lawmaker Dinorah Figuera as opposition figure Maria Corina Machado left out of proceedings.

properties.titulo_evento: Poland protests to Russian ambassador over missile incursion
properties.descricao: Warsaw asserts missile recently made, illustrating Russia's nightly barrage against Ukraine is draining arsenal.

properties.titulo_evento: Why is Israel arming illegal settlers?
properties.descricao: As settler attacks reach record levels, the government has distributed more than 100,000 assault rifles to Israelis.

properties.titulo_evento: New York sues Kalshi, says its prediction markets are ‘illegal gambling’
properties.descricao: New York is one of many states with cases against Kalshi and others in dispute with Trump gov't on who gets to regulate.

properties.titulo_evento: Russia and Ukraine report casualties as they continue to trade attacks

properties.titulo_evento: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace

properties.titulo_evento: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM

properties.titulo_evento: Worth $5m? Visitors react to renovated Washington horse statues
properties.descricao: The Trump Administration has regilded the Arts of War statues near the Lincoln Memorial with 23.75-karat gold.

properties.titulo_evento: UK court allows plans for Chinese 'super' embassy to advance
properties.descricao: A court dismissed a legal challenge against Beijing's new embassy in London, which could become the largest in the UK. The case, brought by a neighborhood association, argued the embassy poses a security threat.

properties.titulo_evento: Humanoid robots: Trump's latest China trade battle?
properties.descricao: The US has banned foreign-made humanoid robots, a market Chinese tech firms dominates. Although Washington cited national security risks, analysts think Donald Trump is buying time for US robot makers to catch up.

properties.titulo_evento: Germany news: Unemployment tops 3 million as industry slumps
properties.descricao: Over three million people are currently unemployed in Germany, with 1.1 million drawing unemployment checks, authorities say. Also, sales of air conditioners have doubled as heat continues to crush cities. DW has more.

properties.titulo_evento: Military flare-up between Houthis and Saudi Arabia challenges relative calm in Yemen
properties.descricao: Riyadh and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels are on the brink of renewed conflict. Could war-ravaged Yemen be drawn into a wider Middle East war?

properties.titulo_evento: Spain's PM visits Ceuta after thousands breached border
properties.descricao: Thousands of people continued pouring into Ceuta from Morocco during the night, after Spanish police lost control of the border. The head of the city government estimated that 60,000 people had entered.

properties.titulo_evento: Spain will send troops to Ceuta to help with border security
properties.descricao: Authorities in the Spanish city of Ceuta asked Madrid to declare a national emergency and send military assistance. Crowds of people breached the border of the territory next to Morocco as police lost control.

properties.titulo_evento: Berlin Pride attack: Are German juvenile courts too lenient?
properties.descricao: The terror attack on Berlin Pride has put the work of juvenile courts into the spotlight. Many argue the 21-year-old perpetrator should have been in prison at the time of the attack.

properties.titulo_evento: Why Germany may stand up against FIFA's World Cup sell off
properties.descricao: Leading figures in German football have lined up to criticize Gianni Infantino’s plans to sell a stake in the World Cup. Germany is showing signs that they may be ready to oppose Infantino's re-election.
